caption: Gentle instrumental film score, nostalgic and tender, a softly plucked lyre in a pentatonic scale over warm felt piano and quiet sustained strings, sparse and intimate, no drums, no lead vocal, leaves room for a narrator

cues.note: Enter softly with the lyre alone.
Piano joins as the children appear; a little more warmth.
The theme returns at its fullest while the children sing.
Resolve and fade under the last line, out by the end card.
